theorem_title: Execution of aggregate band-owner weighted scoring
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandWeightedScore.program_meets (primes : ℕ → ℕ) (rs : List _root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.Record)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hd : d+Nat.clog 2 maxMod+6 ≤ lim.depth)
    (hg : 0 < g) (hq : 0 < q) (hqmax : q ≤ maxMod)
    (ha : a+nA ≤ free) (hb : b+nB ≤ free) (hc : c+nC ≤ free)
    (hrecs : recs+4*rs.length ≤ free) (haux : aux+s ≤ free)
    (hspace : _root_.ThreeSum.LightWeightedScore.space free maxMod g U ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandWeightedScore.word maxMod nA nB nC g rs.length s U : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hrecords : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg μ recs (_root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.cells rs))
    (hflag : ∀ r ∈ rs, r.flag=0 ∨ r.flag=1)
    (hvalid : ∀ r ∈ rs, r.flag=1 → r.a*g ≤ nA ∧ r.b*g ≤ nB ∧ r.c*g ≤ nC)
    (hA : ∀ i < nA, |μ (a+i)| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (hB : ∀ i < nB, |μ (b+i)| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (hC : ∀ i < nC, |μ (c+i)| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (hread : ∀ i < s, μ (aux+i)=(primes i : ℤ))
    (hprime : ∀ i < s, Nat.Prime (primes i))
    (hinj : ∀ i < s, ∀ j < s, primes i=primes j → i=j)
    (hproduct : ∀ i < s, q*primes i ≤ maxMod) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandWeightedScore.program 16 d [a,b,c,nA,nB,nC,g,recs,rs.length,q,aux,s,free] μ
      (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandWeightedScore.time maxMod g rs.length s U)
      (fun result ν => result=(_root_.ThreeSum.BandWeightedScore.score primes s q nA nB nC g
        (fun i => μ (a+i)) (fun i => μ (b+i)) (fun i => μ (c+i)) rs : ℤ) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν free) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let positive band size $g$, base modulus $q\le M$, original arrays A,B,C with lengths $n_A,n_B,n_C$ and magnitude bound $U$, and a list of physical owner records $R$ be retained before free base $f$. Each record has Boolean flag; flagged band starts lie within the corresponding original lengths. Let $s$ auxiliary values be distinct primes, correctly stored before $f$, with $q p_i\le M$. For limits $\lambda$ and depth $d$, assume addresses fit words, the exact scoring space/word budgets fit and $d+\lceil\log_2M\rceil+6$ is allowed. The fixed aggregate scorer returns exactly the sum of the defined weighted modular scores over the flagged owner-band slices, meets its prescribed time and preserves every cell below $f$.

This computes the complete physical false-score quantity used in prime choice and the dense threshold.
